name: Battery Analyst
tagline: Email it a battery question; it runs a physics simulation and replies with capacity, energy and curves.
description:
Describe a cell and a discharge, such as "1C and 2C for an LG M50 at 0 °C and 25 °C", and it runs the cases with PyBaMM, the open-source battery modelling library. It replies with the capacity, energy, duration and voltages of each case, plus the voltage curves and a CSV.

It uses PyBaMM's published parameter sets (LG M50, A123 LFP, Kokam and others) and says which one it chose and what it assumed.

capabilities.name: Discharge simulation
capabilities.description: SPM, SPMe or DFN models at any C-rate and temperature.

capabilities.name: Comparisons
capabilities.description: Up to eight rate and temperature cases in one table.

capabilities.name: Charts and data
capabilities.description: Voltage curves as an image and the results as a CSV.
